storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content: He always wandered by the lakeside with a gloomy expression. Gradually, the students began to refer to the lakeside as "the Territory of the Sullen Half-Fish Man". Thus, he came every day like a lord, solemnly inspecting his domain. When he dove into the lake bottom, the swirling bubbles gently enveloped him; underwater, the jeers from the shore seemed to fade into obscurity.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
A.F. 3@1, January.

On the Devil's Reef off the eastern coast of the Agló Republic, local fishermen reported they had salvaged "a strangely shaped corpse"—short and hunched, with protruding eyeballs, partially hardened skin, webbed fingers, and the most bizarre feature being symmetrical red marks on either side of the neck. If it weren't for the student uniform it wore, it would be hard to consider it a "human corpse." 

When the investigators arrived, the strange corpse had already been burned by frightened fishermen as an omen, leaving only a suitcase that was quite popular among students at the time. The suitcase contained no change of clothes, only some illegible manuscripts, a compass, and a photograph of a middle-aged woman.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Since the @2 incident, Caecus has reconciled with us and become an external member of the Awakening system. His understanding of @1 knowledge is merely superficial, yet he is eager to showcase and share it. 

 In front of people like Tulu, Miryam, and Goliath, he is filled with humility, but he casts a gloomy and unfriendly gaze toward other races—especially humans. Researchers who have read the files understand his paranoia, but some hot-tempered Awakeners cannot tolerate it. This tense atmosphere often requires Sylvia to mediate and diffuse the situation, and a trust relationship has gradually developed between Caecus and Sylvia. 

 Under Sylvia's guidance, Caecus has awakened the "tolerance of higher races," avoiding provocations from others without comment. 

 "That child often recalls his human mother with warmth. It is said that a mother is the benchmark for a child's understanding of the world, and his hostility toward humans is essentially acquired. So, he just lacks some guidance and care," Sylvia wrote in her psychological counseling records.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Caecus despised humans, even as a child. 

Once, he saved a drowning little girl but was accused by other children of being a monster; he tried to keep his distance, yet they chased him, shouting "stinky frogman." 

During those gloomy years, the only glimmer of hope for him came from Uncle Oren's letters. His vast knowledge contained endless tales of monsters that captivated young Caecus. However, the happiness was fleeting, as Uncle Oren inexplicably vanished a few years later.

At the age of 16, Caecus returned to visit his grandfather and accidentally discovered Oren's manuscript. He finally understood the noble meaning hidden within the twisted patterns on his body.

Hmph, humanity is ultimately a lowly species.

From then on, he no longer succumbed to pessimism but patiently waited for the day destiny would arrive.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Haven't you had such dreams? Suddenly inheriting a massive fortune, suddenly gaining immense power... enough to trample those who once disdained and hurt us.

Then, at the moment you wake up, faced with relentless reality, you fall deeper into despair.

But my dream is true, my fate has arrived.

Know this: you are the weak ones.

Can physical frailty and a wilting soul not uphold a noble bloodline? No, that's impossible, because the name Oren is our family's pride and symbol. Endowed with the bloodline and name, I am no longer that bullied freak; I am someone with noble blood.

So... please... stop looking at me with those suffocating eyes...

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Ah... I remember everything! I was... I was trapped by that filthy human blood and failed to transform! How could this be? Where are my gills? Why aren't they moving?! Why!

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Can worldly trials truly awaken the potential of my bloodline? That, I did not anticipate.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Don't think this will earn my gratitude. My noble lineage simply wouldn't allow it.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: The weapon feels handier now.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: Only a seaborne body can bear such supreme power. You must envy me, huh? It's not your fault for being a frail human; just come to terms with it.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: I remember this feeling—that glorious moment is coming...

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: That voice is calling me again... that ethereal sound from the deep abyss!

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: Why? Why haven't I grown gills after the ritual? Did the transformation fail again?! Damn it! Damn it! Damn it!

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: You've invested so much in me... you are indeed more patient than other humans. Do you truly... not despise me?

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: I still haven't grown my gills, but I no longer feel anxious about it. Keeper, I'll be your shield, and protect you with my fins.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: This half-human shell really... disgusts me. I finally got rid of the past, and now I have to recall it again...

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: To think the heir of the great bloodline would stoop to serving a human... Hmph. Don't think you can command me at will.

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Hmph, you frail human do have some talent in command... and I would show you my true power if not for this inferior shell.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: One day, Uncle Ornn will bring me back to my underwater home. Until then, I can reluctantly be your friend.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: "Our family carries a great bloodline; the chosen one will enjoy eternal peace in the deep sea." I never expected to feel this peace after leaving the sea and coming to the academy. You are different from those who bully me, so I won't allow others to bully you either.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Envious? These tough scales are proof of a noble lineage.

daily.title: Chat: About Aequor
daily.content: In my dreams, I often hear the sound of the tide, growing fainter and fainter. I know I might stay here forever, Human.

daily.title: Chat: About Bloodline
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after acquiring any one of Awakeners: "Tulu," "Murphy," "Miryam," or "Goliath".
daily.content: Is that what they call a Genesis Form...? No, it's a bit different from what I imagined. But if I could become like that, it would be great.

daily.title: Chat: About Dusk
daily.content: The sunset on the small hill often reminds me of my days in Cleveland... Cleveland. I can't believe I still remember that name, the place that gave me these scars.

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: Having transcended inferior races, I do not fear such influence. Even if the host body is shattered, the noble bloodline will not perish.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: A school where all is treated equal... I wonder what foolish dreams you harbor. Even if you haven't committed any wrongs, they will still trample you underfoot. I know that feeling.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Favorite things? Seaweed, fish schools, colonnades, mazes... Of course I've seen them! They're all in Uncle Ornn's book!

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Without a doubt, humans. Are there any creatures filthier than humans?

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Before I return to our palace at the bottom of the sea, I will lend you, a mere human, some of the power of Aequor, but only this once.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: The power of my bloodline is surging.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: Victory came effortlessly, even before my bloodline's full awakening.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: Darn it! You—you still look down on me, don't you?!

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Yes... I know you're within me!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: All who have insulted me shall pay the price!
